trips.name: West Highland Way
trips.summary: The northern section of the West Highland Way, from Tyndrum to Fort William.
trips.focus: Sustained climbing, wet-weather kit and comfortable back-to-back trail days.
trips.note: Northern section only. Overnight stops and transfers depend on accommodation availability.
trips.distanceNote: About 69 km; the official short itinerary lists 43 miles.

trips.name: Aiguilles Rouges
trips.summary: A mountain circuit above Chamonix, with views of the Mont Blanc massif.
stops: Lac Blanc area → Moëde Anterne area
trips.focus: Steep climbing, controlled descents and moving confidently over rocky ground.
trips.note: An experienced-mountain-runner trip. Hut stages and a qualified local leader must be arranged before confirmation.
trips.distanceNote: About 50 km, based on the established mountain circuit. Our overnight stages are a proposal, not a booked itinerary.

trips.name: Kepler Track
trips.route: Te Anau → Luxmore → Iris Burn → Te Anau
trips.summary: A loop through Fiordland’s alpine ridges, beech forest and lakeshores.
stops: Iris Burn Hut → Kepler car park
trips.focus: Long descents, exposed ridgelines and carrying everything needed between huts.
trips.note: DOC hut bookings and any required commercial permissions are still to be secured. Add travel and weather-buffer days.
trips.distanceNote: 60 km for the full loop, as published by DOC.

trips.name: Laugavegur
trips.summary: A point-to-point route through rhyolite mountains, lava fields and river valleys.
trips.focus: Pack practice, cold-and-wet preparation and efficient movement on loose terrain.
trips.note: Summer road access, hut availability and river conditions determine the final plan. River crossings need an on-site decision.
trips.distanceNote: Approximately 54–55 km in the trail association’s guide.

trips.name: Fanie Botha Trail
trips.route: Ceylon → Maritzbos → Stables → Mac Mac → Graskop
trips.summary: A forest and escarpment route in the Sabie area of Mpumalanga.
stops: Mac Mac → Graskop via Mac Mac Pools
trips.focus: Uneven forest trails, humid conditions and repeated days with a light pack.
trips.note: The longer Graskop finish is proposed. SAFCOL must reconfirm trail access, hut condition, distances and group arrangements.
trips.distanceNote: About 59 km for the 58.8 km option described in the forestry guide; current alignment must be checked.

trips.name: Kumano Kodo · Kohechi
trips.summary: A mountain pilgrimage route linking Koyasan with Kumano Hongu Taisha.
trips.focus: Steep passes, stone steps and patient, controlled descending.
trips.note: For experienced trail travellers. Every village overnight must be secured; walk through sacred sites and yield to pilgrims.
trips.distanceNote: Approximately 65–70 km, depending on endpoints and current diversions.

trips.name: Torres del Paine · W
trips.route: Grey → Paine Grande → French Valley → Base Torres
trips.summary: The W route in Torres del Paine, including glacier and mountain viewpoints.
stops: Paine Grande → French Valley → Francés area
trips.focus: Wind exposure, long undulating days and enough energy for consecutive climbs.
trips.note: Exact mileage depends on viewpoints and overnight stops. Refuges, access and transfers are unconfirmed; park conditions may change the route.
trips.distanceNote: About 70 km in the operator’s overview; side trips and the final itinerary can increase this.

trips.name: Overland Track
trips.summary: A route through the Cradle Mountain–Lake St Clair National Park.
trips.focus: Self-sufficient pack carrying, changeable weather and sustained time on your feet.
trips.note: The 65 km plan ends at Narcissus with a booked ferry. Track permits, camping and any commercial permissions must be confirmed.
trips.distanceNote: 65 km to Narcissus; walking around Lake St Clair would add about 17.5 km.
